scores.S1: CLOSE-STRENGTH (D-1): close in its range, last hour, last-hour volume, vs sector, sector
scores.S2: FUTURES BUILD (D-1): build-up, OI change, volume, return
scores.S3: COIL AT THE EDGE (D-1): NR7 / inside day, ATR contraction, near the 20-day edge, streak, sector
scores.S4: GAP WITH SECTOR (09:08+): gap / ATR, sector gap, open beyond yesterday's range, build-up
scores.S5: OWN GAP (09:08+): gap vs sector, gap / ATR, volume
scores.S6: PREPARED + OPEN AGREES (09:08+): S1, S2 and the gap its way
scores.S7: SECTOR LEADER (intraday): move, RVOL, vs VWAP, beyond yesterday's range - leaders of a named sector
scores.S8: LAGGARD CATCH-UP (intraday): RVOL, 5-min momentum, near the edge, build-up - followers / laggards above VWAP
scores.S9: AGAINST / ALONE (intraday): vs sector, RVOL, vs NIFTY, own gap - moving against or without its sector
scores.S10: SHARE-ONLY BLEND (intraday): vs NIFTY, RVOL, VWAP, beyond, gap, build-up - no sector gate

gates.G1: only shares in the 3 named sectors
gates.G2: list size set by the market lean
gates.G3: only shares in the 3 named sectors, list size set by the market lean

triggers.E1 ORB5: first close beyond the 09:15-09:19 high (CE) / low (PE), from 09:20
triggers.E2 PDHL: first close beyond yesterday's high (CE) / low (PE)
triggers.E3 VWAP+MOM: above (CE) / below (PE) VWAP and 0.2%+ its way in 3 min
triggers.E4 OPEN-HOLD: 0.3%+ its way from the open, the 09:15 candle's other extreme unbroken, from 09:20
triggers.E5 PULLBACK: a new day extreme its way after 3+ quiet minutes, 0.3%+ from the open, from 09:20
